dataset.title: Transmission Electron Microscopy Dataset for Image Deblurring

primary_paper.title: TEM image restoration from fast image streams

acquisition.registration_note: The publisher manually selected low-quality images and registered them to high-quality images with ECC after manual translation initialization. The prepared archive retains single-channel uint16 TIFF arrays.

selection_rule: Use only image pairs under the publisher's Test split. After validating the archive layout, sort eligible registered Low/GT pairs by normalized member path and use every eligible pair. For each sharp GT, evaluate a fixed 9x9 interior grid using mean absolute residual after Gaussian blur (sigma 3 pixels), greedily retain the five highest-scoring non-overlapping crops with deterministic row/column tie breaks, and assign the same-rank crop to the corresponding sorted Low frame. Selection uses no Low frame, prediction, localization score, or result threshold.
claim_boundary: Coordinates are exact with respect to the publisher-registered image pair and the evaluator's digital crop construction. They are not microscope-stage ground truth, native nested fields of view, or a test of unregistered cross-magnification relocalization.
